property.name: hive.execution.engine
property.description: Enables Apache Tez DAG execution engine over legacy MapReduce, eliminating intermediate HDFS write barriers between query stages and reducing query latency by 3x-10x.

property.name: hive.tez.container.size
property.description: Allocates 8192 MB (8 GB) per YARN container for Tez tasks, providing sufficient headroom for heavy hash joins, co-viewing similarity calculations, and skew buffers.

property.name: hive.tez.java.opts
property.description: JVM heap flags (80% of container size) paired with G1GC to prevent stop-the-world GC pauses during massive multi-way dimension joins.

property.name: tez.runtime.io.sort.mb
property.description: Allocates 1600 MB of buffer memory for sorting mapper and reducer intermediate outputs prior to spilling to disk. Minimizes multi-pass merge spill cycles.

property.name: tez.runtime.unordered.output.buffer.size-mb
property.description: Memory buffer for unordered partition-to-partition data transfers in broadcast/map joins.

property.name: hive.tez.auto.reducer.parallelism
property.description: Enables dynamic reducer estimation at runtime based on the actual physical bytes flowing through upstream vertices. Prevents over-partitioning and reducer starvation.

property.name: hive.tez.min.partition.factor
property.description: Lower bound scaling multiplier for automatically determined Tez reducers.

property.name: hive.tez.max.partition.factor
property.description: Upper bound scaling multiplier for automatically determined Tez reducers.

property.name: hive.default.fileformat
property.description: Sets ORC as the default file format for all new managed and external warehouse tables.

property.name: hive.exec.orc.default.stripe.size
property.description: Sets ORC stripe size to 256 MB (268435456 bytes), enabling large columnar chunks for high-throughput sequential reading of media view history and telemetry facts.

property.name: hive.exec.orc.default.block.size
property.description: Matches HDFS block size to the ORC stripe size (256 MB) ensuring 1:1 alignment between HDFS blocks and ORC stripes, eliminating remote network block reads.

property.name: hive.exec.orc.default.compress
property.description: Uses Snappy compression for balanced decompression velocity and CPU utilization, ideal for interactive BI dashboard queries and ad hoc analytics.

property.name: hive.exec.orc.encoding.strategy
property.description: Prioritizes CPU encoding speed over extreme dictionary compression for fast ETL ingestion.

property.name: hive.exec.orc.compression.strategy
property.description: Optimizes compression algorithms for query response latency and ingestion throughput.

property.name: hive.orc.row.index.stride
property.description: Stores lightweight min/max/null indexes every 10,000 rows. Enables precise row-group skipping on timestamp and identifier predicate filters (predicate pushdown).

property.name: hive.exec.orc.split.strategy
property.description: Hybrid split generation leverages ETLSplitStrategy for large files (parallel footer parsing) and BI SplitStrategy for small files to minimize split planning overhead.

property.name: hive.orc.compute.splits.num.threads
property.description: Number of background threads allocated for concurrent ORC footer split calculation.

property.name: hive.orc.cache.stripe.details.size
property.description: Caches ORC stripe metadata in memory across queries to avoid repetitive NameNode trips.

property.name: hive.vectorized.execution.enabled
property.description: Enables vectorized query execution, processing rows in batches of 1,024 records using CPU SIMD instructions instead of row-by-row iteration.

property.name: hive.vectorized.execution.reduce.enabled
property.description: Extends vectorized processing to reduce tasks (aggregations, joins, window functions).

property.name: hive.vectorized.execution.reduce.groupby.enabled
property.description: Enables vectorized hash aggregation on reduce operators for GROUP BY queries.

property.name: hive.vectorized.execution.mapjoin.native.enabled
property.description: Enables native vectorized fast hash join operator for broadcast joins.

property.name: hive.vectorized.use.row.serde.deserialize
property.description: Allows vectorization even when underlying data passes through SerDe conversion layers.

property.name: hive.vectorized.use.vectorized.input.format
property.description: Leverages native ORC vectorized reader to read columnar batches directly into vectorized row batches.

property.name: hive.vectorized.adaptor.usage.mode
property.description: Dynamically chooses vectorization adaptors when operators support partial vectorized evaluation.

property.name: hive.cbo.enable
property.description: Enables Apache Calcite Cost-Based Optimizer (CBO) to determine optimal multi-table join ordering, filter pushdowns, and partition pruning.

property.name: hive.compute.query.using.stats
property.description: Answers metadata-driven queries (e.g., SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(dt), MAX(dt)) directly from Metastore statistics without launching MapReduce/Tez tasks.

property.name: hive.stats.autogather
property.description: Automatically generates table and partition statistics during INSERT INTO / INSERT OVERWRITE jobs.

property.name: hive.stats.column.autogather
property.description: Automatically captures column-level NDV (Number of Distinct Values), null counts, and min/max values for exact CBO cost modeling.

property.name: hive.stats.fetch.column.stats
property.description: Directs the CBO planner to fetch column stats from the Metastore for join selectivity calculation.

property.name: hive.stats.fetch.partition.stats
property.description: Directs the CBO planner to fetch partition-level row counts and byte sizes.

property.name: hive.exec.dynamic.partition
property.description: Permits dynamic creation of Hive partitions at query runtime based on column expressions.

property.name: hive.exec.dynamic.partition.mode
property.description: Allows dynamic partitioning across all partition columns without requiring at least one static partition column in the INSERT statement.

property.name: hive.exec.max.dynamic.partitions
property.description: Total maximum dynamic partitions that can be created by a single Hive query across the cluster.

property.name: hive.exec.max.dynamic.partitions.pernode
property.description: Maximum dynamic partitions that can be created per individual cluster TaskTracker/NodeManager.

property.name: hive.exec.max.created.files
property.description: Maximum number of physical HDFS files that can be created by a single ETL dynamic partition job.

property.name: hive.error.on.empty.partition
property.description: Prevents query failure if a dynamic partition evaluation returns zero matching rows.

property.name: hive.auto.convert.join
property.description: Automatically converts common shuffle joins into high-speed broadcast MapJoins when small dimension tables are joined with massive fact tables.

property.name: hive.auto.convert.join.noconditionaltask
property.description: Enables non-conditional task generation for MapJoins when total size of joined tables falls within the noconditionaltask threshold.

property.name: hive.auto.convert.join.noconditionaltask.size
property.description: Sets the broadcast MapJoin threshold to 512 MB (536870912 bytes). Dimensions up to 512 MB (e.g., content catalog, channels, device lookup) are broadcast into memory, skipping shuffle.

property.name: hive.mapjoin.smalltable.filesize
property.description: Legacy fallback threshold (25 MB) for small table classification in MapJoins.

property.name: hive.merge.mapfiles
property.description: Merges small files at the end of a map-only job to prevent HDFS NameNode inode saturation.

property.name: hive.merge.mapredfiles
property.description: Merges small files at the end of a MapReduce / Tez job.

property.name: hive.merge.tezfiles
property.description: Merges small files produced at the final sink vertex of a Tez DAG.

property.name: hive.merge.size.per.task
property.description: Target merged file size of 256 MB (matching HDFS block and ORC stripe size).

property.name: hive.merge.smallfiles.avgsize
property.description: Triggers merge task if the average output file size in a partition is less than 128 MB.

property.name: hive.exec.parallel
property.description: Executes independent stages of a query tree in parallel (e.g. subqueries, multi-insert joins).

property.name: hive.exec.parallel.thread.number
property.description: Allows up to 16 independent query stages to execute concurrently within a single DAG session.

property.name: hive.server2.thrift.max.worker.threads
property.description: Allocates worker threads for HiveServer2 to comfortably serve concurrent BI and ETL connections.
